correctness.rationale: All definitions and ranges are fixed by the 18-cycle plus nine chords. Eleven independent rows and seven independently verified kernel vectors certify rank 11. A minimum cardinality bound of 5, the full geometric classification of its 18 attaining sets, three-wise uniform column certificates, complements and variance give the exact enumerator. Both standalone exhaustive verifiers reconstruct the graph independently and enumerate all 262144 subsets, all 816 triples and the 153 center pairs. The three-move graph metric is verified by BFS on all eighteen states; no extrapolation beyond the finite object is asserted.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic distance-regular bipartite graph, making closed-neighborhood parity a natural object. The exact coset weight spectrum and strength-three coordinate-uniformity are natural finite code invariants not determined by the existing scalar odd-domination framework. The complete 18-optimum classification and sharp mobility threshold capture a meaningful design distinction between combinatorially abundant feasible sets and completely rigid minimal choices; the combined precise fact is useful in parity-monitoring and reconfiguration comparisons. Its value does not depend on the generic connectedness corollary or on a claimed infinite-family extension.
